literal: Ancestral wealth and character it will destroy, gambling hall's time if one enters.
translation: If one spends their time entering the gambling hall, it will destroy both their ancestral wealth and their good character.
modern: சூதாடும் இடத்திற்குச் சென்று காலத்தைக் கழித்தால், அது ஒருவருடைய தொன்மையான செல்வத்தையும் நல்ல பண்பையும் அழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the destructive nature of spending time in gambling halls. The word 'பழகிய' refers to wealth that has been in the family for generations, showing that even deep-rooted prosperity is not safe from this vice. Similarly, 'பண்பும்' highlights that gambling ruins not just material wealth but also one's moral character. Entering the gambling hall ('கழகத்து') and wasting time ('காலை') there will inevitably lead to the total loss of both.
